purpose: Mechanical acquired-read preparation equivalence; no legal quality, corpus holdout or performance certification
static_empty_rule: Empty selected source remains present with no spans. Span-only faults are explicitly inactive for empty; source metadata/ACL faults still apply. Such duplicate states remain visible in the census.
comparison: Exact success values including span and mapping order
Input state unchanged by acquired_blocks except explicit fixture transitions
Exact offer_choices menus/actions/events/state and restored connection_scope_spans
Successful repeated control/checker fixture reduces original-read calls
Control-disabled, empty and checker-absent states do not introduce store checks
Failed results never become successful cached results
Return-value mutation, new preparation and other session cannot inherit stale coverage
failure_policy: Preserve the first complete mismatch and partial census. Do not modify candidate, matrix or existing output after observing execution results; report blocking failure to owner.
scope_limits: Finite synthetic states only, not all Python objects or concurrent mutable-store behavior
Native immutable-store check_unchanged contract is required for cache hits
No product answer, prompt, dataset, model, budget or MAIN pointer mutation
